Mia (CS): quick heads up — NoriHealth saw a ~35% token cost spike in last night's activation batch. digging into traces; looks like model routing fell back to larger variant for a chunk. thinking proactive rec: small int8 quant trial + 10% canary routing to compact variant. thoughts?
Sam (Success): timeline? renewal in 6 weeks, we should avoid any user-facing regressions. can we run short eval over their prompt set first?
Rana (SE): +1 on eval. I can run a 500-case promptset locally. propose: 
- 10% traffic to compact-int8 variant
- 90% stays on baseline
- monitor top-5 prompt failure modes and latency percentiles
If eval looks fine we can ramp to 30% over 48h.
Devon (Eng): for canary infra, add routing rule in console: 
```json
{"route": "norihealth", "percent": 10, "target_model": "gpt-compact-int8-v2"}
```
Ops-bot: Scheduled canary: norihealth -> gpt-compact-int8-v2 at 10% starting 2026-04-03T02:00Z (duration 48h). I'll post metrics when available. :robot_face:
Mia (CS): thanks. Rana — can you add the eval results (latency P95, avg tokens saved, any hallucination regression notes) here when done? I'll draft a short customer note explaining pre-emptive optimization to avoid bill shock.
Rana (SE): yep. starting eval now. ETA ~2 hours. I'll push results and sample diffs. If any semantic mismatches I'll flag for a rollback.
Sam (Success): Also capture feedback: ask product team if they can provide 10-20 “sensitive” prompts we should watch for accuracy.
Mia (CS): good call. pinging @product to get prompt set. will update timeline.
Devon (Eng): one more: if KV cache warms slowly on compact model, we should enable prefix caching for first 2 tokens — add this to canary config if we see cold-start latency.
Mia (CS): noted. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
